---
name: Change request
about: Propose a change before writing it (CONTRIBUTING asks for an issue first)
labels: enhancement
---

<!-- A security problem is never a public issue. Report it privately as SECURITY.md says. -->

**What should change, in one or two sentences**

**Why it is needed** (Oathline is small on purpose: the bar is "clearly correct and clearly needed")

**What could go wrong** (which refusal, record or limit does it touch?)

**Does it keep the ground rules?** Standard library only; deterministic; fail closed; a test for every behaviour change.
